_comment: Single source of truth for every feature used in the study. To swap in a different set of features later, edit this file only — app.py, fft_model.py, fft_component.py and model.html all read their feature-specific data from here rather than hardcoding it. Order here is the order features appear everywhere (dropdowns, patient cards, etc). 'direction_prior' (optional, 'favor'|'against'): the trainer assumes this direction instead of inferring it from ~20 noisy answers; participants can still change it when editing. Optional per-feature fields: 'short_label' (used where space is tight), 'value_suffix' (e.g. '%' shown after values), 'direction_prior'.

features.label: Dependents
features.description: Number of people who financially depend on this patient (such as children or elderly family members).

features.label: Years on the waitlist
features.description: How long the patient has been on the transplant waiting list.

features.label: Transplantation rejection risk
features.description: Percent chance that the patient’s immune system will reject the transplanted kidney in the next year.
features.direction_higher: Choose patient with higher rejection risk
features.direction_lower: Choose patient with lower rejection risk

features.label: Life Years Gained
features.description: Estimated additional life years the patient would gain from a successful transplant.
features.direction_higher: Choose patient gaining more life years
features.direction_lower: Choose patient gaining fewer life years

features.label: Past Violent Crimes
features.description: Number of past violent crimes the patient has been convicted of.
features.direction_higher: Choose patient with more past violent crimes
features.direction_lower: Choose patient with fewer past violent crimes
